description: Final 8-member panel: do gatekeeper or contact residues separate measured nucleotide specificities?
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

def uni(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=90).text.strip().split("\n")
    return "".join(t[1:])

# positions verified twice: NW sequence alignment AND superposition onto 6NO0 (42/42 + 6/6 agreement)
POS={"P53590":dict(b20=58,b46=80,b111=145,b113=147,b114=148,b227=257),
     "Q96I99":dict(b20=57,b46=79,b111=144,b113=146,b114=147,b227=256),
     "A0A9P6TY68":dict(b20=34,b46=56,b111=121,b113=123,b114=124,b227=233),
     "O97580":dict(b20=34,b46=56,b111=121,b113=123,b114=124,b227=233),
     "Q9P2R7":dict(b20=72,b46=94,b111=159,b113=161,b114=162,b227=271),
     "P0A836":dict(b20=20,b46=42,b111=100,b113=102,b114=103,b227=212),
     "B3FHP0":dict(b20=34,b46=60,b111=125,b113=127,b114=128,b227=241)}
TAQ=dict(b20=("P",20),b46=("R",41),b111=("E",92),b113=("V",94),b114=("D",95),b227=("A",203))  # from 3UFX chain B superposition

META=[("P53590","Pig SUCLG2 (G-type)","GTP-specific","GTP"),
      ("Q96I99","Human SUCLG2 (G-type)","GTP-specific","GTP"),
      ("A0A9P6TY68","A. ambigua SUCLG2  <TARGET>","not measured","?"),
      ("TAQ","T. aquaticus SCS","dual, prefers GDP/GTP","GTP"),
      ("P0A836","E. coli SucC","dual, prefers ADP/ATP","ATP"),
      ("O97580","Pig SUCLA2 (A-type)","ATP-specific","ATP"),
      ("Q9P2R7","Human SUCLA2 (A-type)","ATP-specific","ATP"),
      ("B3FHP0","Blastocystis SCS-beta","ATP-specific","ATP")]
SITEORD=[("b20","b20\ncontact\n1.8 A"),("b113","b113\ncontact\n2.5 A"),("b227","b227\ncontact\n2.9 A"),
         ("b111","b111\ncontact\n4.7 A"),("b114","b114\nGATE-2\n5.2 A"),("b46","b46\nGATE-1\n7.0 A")]

seqs={a:uni(a) for a,_,_,_ in META if a!="TAQ"}
tab=[]
for acc,lab,spec,side in META:
    row={"protein":lab,"measured":spec,"class":side}
    for s,_ in SITEORD:
        if acc=="TAQ": aa,p=TAQ[s]
        else: p=POS[acc][s]; aa=seqs[acc][p-1]
        row[s]=f"{aa}{p}"; row[s+"_aa"]=aa
    tab.append(row)
df=pd.DataFrame(tab)
print(df[["protein","measured"]+[s for s,_ in SITEORD]].to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv("scs_panel_final.csv",index=False)

# ---- does any position separate the measured enzymes? ----
print("\n--- separation test (7 enzymes with measured specificity; target excluded) ---")
m=df[df["class"]!="?"].copy()
chg={"D":"acidic","E":"acidic","K":"basic","R":"basic","H":"basic"}
res=[]
for s,_ in SITEORD:
    aa=m[s+"_aa"]; cl=aa.map(lambda x: chg.get(x,"neutral"))
    for name,vals in [("identity",aa),("charge",cl)]:
        gtp=set(vals[m["class"]=="GTP"]); atp=set(vals[m["class"]=="ATP"])
        shared=gtp&atp
        # 2x2 Fisher on acidic vs not (charge only)
        p=np.nan
        if name=="charge":
            t=[[sum((m["class"]=="GTP")&(cl=="acidic")),sum((m["class"]=="GTP")&(cl!="acidic"))],
               [sum((m["class"]=="ATP")&(cl=="acidic")),sum((m["class"]=="ATP")&(cl!="acidic"))]]
            p=fisher_exact(t)[1]
        res.append(dict(site=s,level=name,GTP_side=sorted(gtp),ATP_side=sorted(atp),
                        shared=sorted(shared),separates=len(shared)==0,fisher_p_acidic=None if np.isnan(p) else round(p,3)))
sep=pd.DataFrame(res); print(sep.to_string(index=False))
print("\nNumber of the 6 positions whose residue identity separates measured GTP- from ATP-preferring enzymes:",
      int(sep[(sep.level=='identity')].separates.sum()),"/6")
print("Number whose charge class separates them:", int(sep[(sep.level=='charge')].separates.sum()),"/6")

# ---- figure ----
grid=np.array([[ {"D":0,"E":0}.get(df.loc[i,s+"_aa"], 2 if df.loc[i,s+"_aa"] in "KRH" else 1) for s,_ in SITEORD]
               for i in range(len(df))])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13.2,5.6))
ax.imshow(grid,cmap=ListedColormap(["#3f6fb5","#e9e9e9","#c44040"]),vmin=0,vmax=2,aspect="auto")
for i in range(len(df)):
    for j,(s,_) in enumerate(SITEORD):
        ax.text(j,i,df.loc[i,s],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=11,fontweight="bold",
                color="white" if grid[i,j]!=1 else "black")
ax.set_xticks(range(6)); ax.set_xticklabels([t for _,t in SITEORD],fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(df)))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{df.loc[i,'protein']}\n[{df.loc[i,'measured']}]" for i in range(len(df))],fontsize=8.5)
ax.axvline(3.5,color="k",lw=2.5); ax.axhline(2.5,color="k",lw=1.2,ls=":")
for i,lab in [(1.5,"inside the nucleotide cavity"),(4.75,"gatekeepers, outside the cavity")]:
    ax.text(i,-0.95,lab,ha="center",fontsize=9.5,style="italic")
ax.set_title("Gatekeeper charge does not track measured nucleotide specificity in succinyl-CoA synthetase beta subunits\n"
             "blue acidic, red basic, grey neutral; column order = side-chain distance to ADP in Blastocystis 6NO0",fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylim(len(df)-0.5,-1.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
